releases.notes:
Update and feedback testing release / 更新与问题反馈测试版

Android 0.19.4-aex.105 (versionCode 123): own-project update checks, persistent stable/testing channel preferences, verified APK download and explicit system installation. About > Report a problem previews and copies an allowlisted software summary, then opens this repository's public GitHub Issue form. GitHub sign-in is required to submit; logs are not uploaded automatically.

Windows 0.11.20.7: own-project update checks and release notes, with explicit manual download/replacement. Report a problem uses the same safe-summary workflow. Exit the app before replacing the entire unpacked application directory; the ZIP includes its runtime.

This is a small-distribution testing release. Existing installations without the new updater must install this release manually once. Automatic checks are low-frequency; this is not an instant-push service. Current validation is limited to the update/feedback scope, not a claim that all project modules pass. Android physical-device/vendor-specific behavior and the authenticated browser form submission are not claimed as completed device acceptance.

免登录反馈 Android 测试候选 / Account-free feedback Android testing candidate

Android 0.19.4-aex.106（versionCode 124）保留原正式包名与证书。“关于 → 报告问题”预览并可选复制安全摘要，然后打开免登录反馈表单。用户填写标题和描述、明确同意公开后提交；网页先返回持久化回执，后台再转交本仓库 GitHub Issues。无需用户注册任何账号，不自动上传日志，不支持附件或私密反馈。反馈内容将公开。

真实未登录浏览器 → 生产 Turnstile → D1 回执 → GitHub 自测 Issue #8 已验证；该自测已关闭。共享/双端反馈 focused 14 项及服务/网页 24 项通过，独立审查与限定修复复验通过。本说明不代表其他模块全量通过或实体设备/厂商系统验收。

已有自有更新机制的 Android 安装可在 testing 通道收到本候选；索引部署完成前可手动下载。更新为低频检查，不是即时推送。Windows 原正式发布未在此版本中更新；新的免登录 Windows 体验包不冒充正式更新资产。所有用户也可直接访问 https://altaircardinal.github.io/mihon-desktop/feedback/ 使用同一免登录表单。
